message: I have a dear friend who tends to panic at the slightest hint of trouble. Last week, she called me in a tizzy because of a thunderstorm warning. I calmly reminded her about the go-bag I helped her pack last year, and it seemed to ease her mind a bit. Sometimes, it’s just about having a little plan that keeps us grounded amidst the chaos. How do you keep calm when things get a bit stormy?
